underlines.text: come to report a fair wind to him

reference.text: The three corresponding new sails were now bent and reefed, and a storm-trysail was set further aft; so that the ship soon went through the water with some precision again; and the course—for the present, East-south-east—which he was to steer, if practicable, was once more given to the helmsman.
Fair for death and doom,—that’s fair for Moby Dick.
